sentences.zh: 勇敢善射，以經學中第，至國子博士。

translations.literal: Brave and skilled in archery, he passed the examination in the Classics and rose to Doctor of the National University.
translations.idiomatic: Brave and skilled in archery, he passed the Classics examination and rose to Doctor of the National University.

sentences.zh: 淳化中，知陵州。

translations.literal: During Chunhua he was made prefect of Ling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chunhua reign he was made prefect of Ling Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時李順構亂，連下城邑。

translations.literal: At the time Li Shun was plotting rebellion and captured city after city.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Li Shun was rebelling and capturing cities one after another.

sentences.zh: 賊黨數萬攻陵州，州兵不滿三百，舊不設城塹。

translations.literal: Several tens of thousands of bandits attacked Ling Prefecture; prefectural troops numbered fewer than three hundred, and formerly no moat had been built.
translations.idiomatic: Tens of thousands of rebels attacked Ling Prefecture. The garrison had fewer than three hundred men and no moat had ever been built.

sentences.zh: 旦修完戰具，置鹿角砦，驅市人進戰，大敗之，殺五千餘人，獲器械萬計。

translations.literal: Dan repaired weapons and equipment, set up abatis stockades, drove townspeople into battle, utterly defeated them, killed more than five thousand, and captured tens of thousands of weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Dan repaired arms, built abatis stockades, pressed townspeople into battle, routed the rebels, killed more than five thousand, and captured tens of thousands of weapons.

sentences.zh: 詔書褒之，特遷水部員外郎，賜緋魚，由是知名。

translations.literal: An edict praised him; he was specially promoted to Outer Gentleman of the Water Bureau and bestowed red fish insignia, and from this became well known.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised him. He was specially promoted to Outer Gentleman of the Water Bureau and given red fish insignia, and from then on was widely known.

sentences.zh: 數月，西川招安使上官正言：「雅州密邇蠻蜑，在於鎮撫須得其人，伏見水部員外郎張旦，前守陵州，以孤軍抗群寇，保全壁壘，至今劍外伏其威名。

translations.literal: Several months later the Western Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Shang Guanzheng said: "Yazhou is close to the Man and Luo peoples; in pacification one must have the right man. I humbly observe Outer Gentleman of the Water Bureau Zhang Dan: formerly defending Ling Prefecture, with a lone army he resisted a host of bandits, preserved the walls, and to this day beyond the Sword the people submit to his awe-inspiring name.
translations.idiomatic: Months later Western Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Shang Guanzheng memorialized: "Yazhou lies close to tribal peoples and needs the right man to pacify it. I observe that Zhang Dan, formerly Outer Gentleman of the Water Bureau, held Ling Prefecture with a lone army against a great host, preserved the walls, and is still feared beyond the Sword Pass.

sentences.zh: 望改授諸司使，令知州事。

translations.literal: I hope he may be transferred to a commissioner of the various offices and made to administer the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that he be made a commissioner and put in charge of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 」上以省郎之重，不欲換他職，乃授刑部員外郎，賜金紫。

translations.literal: " The emperor, considering the weight of a provincial official, did not wish to change him to another post; he thereupon appointed him Outer Gentleman of the Punishments Bureau and bestowed gold and purple.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, unwilling to move a provincial official into another post, made him Outer Gentleman of the Punishments Bureau and granted gold and purple insignia.

sentences.zh: 乘傳之任，寇不敢犯。

translations.literal: Traveling by relay horse to his post, bandits did not dare violate his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Traveling by imperial relay to his post, bandits did not dare enter his jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 又虎翼都虞候胡福戍軍城，率兵力戰，金創遍體，猶奮劍轉鬥，矢無虛發，麾下已盡，獨挺刃殺數十人。

translations.literal: Also Tiger Wing Chief Commandant Hu Fu garrisoned the army city, led troops in fierce battle, wounds covered his whole body, yet he still wielded his sword and fought in circles, arrows never missing, his subordinates were exhausted, and alone he thrust his blade and killed several tens.
translations.idiomatic: Tiger Wing Chief Commandant Hu Fu also garrisoned the army city and fought fiercely. Wounds covered his body, yet he still wheeled and fought, never missing with his arrows. When his men were gone, he alone killed dozens with his blade.

sentences.zh: 副指揮使尚祚能運大撾，所斬首拉脅者，亦百餘人，眾寡不敵，遂與指揮使張睿、劉福、都頭輔能等四人並死之。

translations.literal: Deputy Commander Shang Zuoneng wielded a great mace; those whose heads and ribs he smashed also numbered more than a hundred; they were outnumbered, and thereupon together with Commanders Zhang Rui, Liu Fu, Squad Leader Funeng, and four others in all they died.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Commander Shang Zuoneng wielded a great mace and smashed more than a hundred heads and ribs. Outnumbered, he died together with Commanders Zhang Rui and Liu Fu, Squad Leader Funeng, and three others.

sentences.zh: 真宗嘉歎其忠勇，遣使訪遺骸，唯得福屍，命其子厚葬之。

translations.literal: Zhenzong sighed in admiration at their loyalty and courage, sent an envoy to search for their remains, and only Fu's corpse was found; he ordered his son to bury it with full honors.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenzong praised their loyalty and courage, sent an envoy to recover their remains, and found only Fu's body. He ordered Fu's son to give him a full burial.

sentences.zh: 贈福洺州團練使，祚濱州刺史，睿演州刺史，劉福臨州刺史，能等並贈諸衛率府副率。

translations.literal: Fu was posthumously granted Militia Commissioner of Mingzhou, Zuo Prefect of Binzhou, Rui Prefect of Yanzhou, Liu Fu Prefect of Linzhou, and Funeng and the rest were all posthumously granted Deputy Commandants of the Guard Rate Offices.
translations.idiomatic: Fu was posthumously made Militia Commissioner of Mingzhou; Zuo was made prefect of Binzhou; Rui of Yanzhou; Liu Fu of Linzhou; and Funeng and the others were all made Deputy Commandants of the Guard Rate Offices.

sentences.zh: 又邯鄲令李晦辭赴任，值道梗，留德清同拒敵；

translations.literal: Also Handan Magistrate Li Huici was going to his post, found the road blocked, and remained at Deqing to resist the enemy together;
translations.idiomatic: Handan Magistrate Li Huici was traveling to his post, found the roads blocked, and stayed at Deqing to resist the enemy.

sentences.zh: 侍禁夏承皓部兵至大名界遇敵，皆戰沒。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Xia Chenghao led troops to the border of Daming, encountered the enemy, and all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Xia Chenghao led troops to the Daming border, met the enemy, and all were killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 贈晦辭工部員外郎，承皓崇儀使。

translations.literal: Huici was posthumously granted Outer Gentleman of the Works Bureau; Chenghao Ceremonial Rites Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Huici was posthumously made Outer Gentleman of the Works Bureau; Chenghao was made Ceremonial Rites Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時又贈受事河朔而沒者，殿直劉超供備庫使，入內高班內品李知順為六宅副使，奉職胡度等三人為內殿崇班，仍各錄其子，及賜其家金帛。

translations.literal: At the time those who died serving in Hebei were also posthumously rewarded: Palace Attendant Liu Chao Supply Commissioner, Inner Service Senior Attendant Li Zhishun Deputy Commissioner of the Six Residences, Service Officer Hu Du and three others Inner Hall Attendants of the Honored Class; their sons were all entered into service, and their families were bestowed gold and silk.
translations.idiomatic: Others who died serving in Hebei were also rewarded: Liu Chao was made Supply Commissioner; Li Zhishun Deputy Commissioner of the Six Residences; Hu Du and three others Inner Hall Attendants; their sons were enrolled in service and their families given gold and silk.

sentences.zh: 張煦，字輔暘，開封人。

translations.literal: Zhang Xu, courtesy name Fuyang, was a native of Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xu, whose courtesy name was Fuyang, came from Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 開寶末，補府中牙職。

translations.literal: At the end of Kaibao he entered service as a yamen clerk in the prefectural office.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Kaibao reign he entered service as a yamen clerk in the prefectural office.

sentences.zh: 雍熙二年，自陳太宗尹京嘗事左右，命為殿前承旨，遷殿直、歙州監軍。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongxi he stated that when Taizong was Prince of Jing he had served at his side; he was ordered to be Palace Front Commissioner and was promoted to Palace Attendant and Supervisory Commissioner of Shezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongxi he said he had served Taizong when the emperor was Prince of Jing. He was made Palace Front Commissioner, then Palace Attendant and supervisory commissioner of Shezhou.

sentences.zh: 凶人黃行達弟坐法抵死，行達誣州將故入其罪，詔宣州通判姚鉉與煦鞫之，即日決遣。

translations.literal: The younger brother of the vicious man Huang Xingda was condemned to death by law; Xingda falsely accused the prefectural general of deliberately entering him into guilt; an edict ordered Xuanzhou Vice Prefect Yao Xian together with Xu to try the case, and on the same day it was decided and dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: When the younger brother of the criminal Huang Xingda was sentenced to death, Xingda falsely accused the prefectural commander. By edict Yao Xian, vice prefect of Xuanzhou, and Xu tried the case and resolved it the same day.

sentences.zh: 還擢供奉官、閤門祗候。

translations.literal: On his return he was promoted to Presentation Officer and Gate Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was promoted to Presentation Officer and Gate Attendant.

sentences.zh: 占謝日，又改內殿崇班、鎮定、邢、趙、山西、土門路都巡檢使。

translations.literal: On the day of his audience of thanks he was again changed to Inner Hall Attendant of the Honored Class and Chief Inspector of the Zhen-Ding, Xing, Zhao, Shanxi, and Tumen routes.
translations.idiomatic: On the day he thanked the throne for his appointment he was made Inner Hall Attendant of the Honored Class and Chief Inspector of the Zhen-Ding, Xing, Zhao, Shanxi, and Tumen routes.

sentences.zh: 契丹騎兵剽境上，煦以所部斬首數十，走之。

translations.literal: Khitan cavalry raided the borderlands; Xu with his command beheaded several tens and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: When Khitan cavalry raided the border, Xu beheaded dozens with his troops and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 葛霸、周瑩、李繼宣稱其幹舉，有詔嘉獎。

translations.literal: Ge Ba, Zhou Ying, and Li Jixuan praised his capable administration; there was an edict of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Ba, Zhou Ying, and Li Jixuan praised his capable administration, and he received an edict of commendation.

sentences.zh: 代還，拜供備庫副使，權知環州。

translations.literal: When replaced and returned he was appointed Deputy Supply Commissioner and acting administrator of Huanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to court, he was made Deputy Supply Commissioner and acting administrator of Huanzhou.

sentences.zh: 數月，改岢嵐軍使，又知保安軍。

translations.literal: Several months later he was changed to Commander of Kelan Army and again made administrator of Bao'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: Several months later he became commander of Kelan Army and administrator of Bao'an Army.

sentences.zh: 咸平中，王均亂蜀，以煦為綿、漢、劍門路都巡檢使。

translations.literal: During Xianping, when Wang Jun rebelled in Shu, Xu was made Chief Inspector of the Mian, Han, and Jianmen route.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianping reign, when Wang Jun rebelled in Shu, Xu was made Chief Inspector of the Mian, Han, and Jianmen route.

sentences.zh: 又與雷有終進攻成都，煦主東砦，焚其郛及樓堞，均突圍而遁。

translations.literal: He again joined Lei Youzhong in attacking Chengdu; Xu commanded the eastern stockade, burned the outer walls and towers, and Jun broke out and fled.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Lei Youzhong in attacking Chengdu, commanded the eastern stockade, burned the outer walls and towers, and Wang Jun broke out and fled.

sentences.zh: 賊平，以功就遷正使，徙益州都監，與知州宋太初同提總本路諸軍事。

translations.literal: When the bandits were pacified, for his merit he was promoted in office to Chief Commissioner, moved to Chief Supervisor of Yizhou, and together with Prefect Song Taichu jointly directed all military affairs of the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebellion was crushed he was promoted to chief commissioner, made chief supervisor of Yizhou, and together with Prefect Song Taichu directed all military affairs of the circuit.

sentences.zh: 有戰艦卒將謀擾動，煦即日斬之。

translations.literal: A warship soldier plotted disturbance; Xu beheaded him the same day.
translations.idiomatic: When a warship soldier plotted mutiny, Xu executed him the same day.

sentences.zh: 夏人寇邊，改涇原儀渭都鈐轄。

translations.literal: When the Xia people raided the border he was changed to Commissioner of the Jingyuan, Yi, and Wei circuit.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tangut raided the frontier he was made Commissioner of the Jingyuan, Yi, and Wei circuit.

sentences.zh: 又為邠寧環慶路鈐轄兼巡檢、安撫都監，累躡寇入賊中，掩殺甚眾，有詔嘉獎。

translations.literal: He again served as Commissioner of the Bin-Ning-Huan-Qing circuit together with Inspector and Pacification Chief Supervisor; repeatedly he followed the bandits into their territory and in surprise attacks killed a great many; there was an edict of praise.
translations.idiomatic: He again served as commissioner of the Bin-Ning-Huan-Qing circuit with inspector and pacification duties, repeatedly pursued raiders into their territory in surprise attacks, killed many, and received praise from court.

sentences.zh: 會遣王超、張凝、秦翰援靈武，命煦為西路行營都監。

translations.literal: It happened that Wang Chao, Zhang Ning, and Qin Han were sent to relieve Lingwu; Xu was ordered to be Western Route Field Headquarters Chief Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Chao, Zhang Ning, and Qin Han were sent to relieve Lingwu, Xu was made Western Route Field Headquarters Chief Supervisor.

sentences.zh: 至鎮戎，聞靈武已陷，復還本任。

translations.literal: When he reached Zhenrong he heard that Lingwu had already fallen and returned to his original post.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhenrong he learned that Lingwu had fallen and returned to his original post.

sentences.zh: 與張凝入西夏境，出白豹鎮，至柔遠川，夏人七百餘邀戰，煦與慶州監軍張綸擊殺甚眾。

translations.literal: Together with Zhang Ning he entered Western Xia territory, went out from Baibao Town to Rouyuan River; more than seven hundred Xia people intercepted and fought; Xu together with Supervisory Commissioner of Qingzhou Zhang Lun attacked and killed a great many.
translations.idiomatic: With Zhang Ning he entered Tangut territory from Baibao Town to Rouyuan River. More than seven hundred Tanguts attacked; Xu and Qingzhou supervisor Zhang Lun killed many.

sentences.zh: 清遠故城有酋長，請以甲騎三萬來降。

translations.literal: At the old city of Qingyuan a chieftain requested to come over with thirty thousand armored horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: At the old Qingyuan city a chieftain offered to surrender with thirty thousand armored horsemen.

sentences.zh: 煦與凝曰：「此詐也。

translations.literal: Xu said to Ning: "This is a deception."
translations.idiomatic: Xu told Ning, "This is a ruse."

sentences.zh: 」亟嚴兵以待之，果然。

translations.literal: " He urgently arrayed troops to await them, and indeed it was so.
translations.idiomatic: He urgently arrayed his troops to receive them, and so it proved.

sentences.zh: 凝按部歸環州，道為敵所邀。

translations.literal: Ning was leading his command back to Huanzhou when on the road he was intercepted by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Ning was leading his command back to Huanzhou when the enemy intercepted him on the road.

sentences.zh: 煦聞之，領所部銳兵自慶州赴之，一昔與凝會，射殺其大將，與凝同還。

translations.literal: When Xu heard of it he led his crack troops from Qingzhou to go to his aid; in one night he joined Ning, shot and killed their great general, and returned together with Ning.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing this, Xu led crack troops from Qingzhou to his aid. In one night he joined Ning, shot and killed the enemy general, and returned with him.

sentences.zh: 東封歲，權河陽鈐轄，遷文思使、知曹州。

translations.literal: In the year of the eastern fengshan rites he acted as Commissioner of Heyang, was promoted to Commissioner of Literary Elegance and made prefect of Caozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the year of the eastern fengshan rites he acted as Commissioner of Heyang, then was made Commissioner of Literary Elegance and prefect of Caozhou.

sentences.zh: 會江、淮災歉，分命大藩長吏綏撫，以煦為江南西路安撫都監。

translations.literal: It happened that the Jianghuai region suffered disaster and poor harvest; the court separately ordered great frontier prefects to pacify and comfort; Xu was made Pacification Chief Supervisor of Jiangnan West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jianghuai region suffered famine, the court sent great frontier officials to comfort the people, and Xu was made Pacification Chief Supervisor of Jiangnan West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 俄還濟陰，加北作坊使，又徙滄州，就轉宮苑使，領康州刺史。

translations.literal: Shortly he returned to Jiyin, was given the additional title of Commissioner of the Northern Workshops, again moved to Cangzhou, and at the same time transferred to Commissioner of the Palace Parks and given charge of Kangzhou as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: He soon returned to Jiyin, was made Commissioner of the Northern Workshops, transferred to Cangzhou, then made Commissioner of the Palace Parks and prefect of Kangzhou.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符九年，加領昭州團練使、知鄜州。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Dazhong Xiangfu he was given the additional charge of Militia Commissioner of Zhaozhou and made administrator of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Dazhong Xiangfu he was also made Militia Commissioner of Zhaozhou and administrator of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復知滄州。

translations.literal: Before long he again became prefect of Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he again became prefect of Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 天禧三年，拜西上閤門使，徙幷代鈐轄。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianxi he was appointed Western Upper Gate Commissioner and transferred to Commissioner of Bing and Dai.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tianxi he was made Western Upper Gate Commissioner and transferred to Commissioner of Bing and Dai.

sentences.zh: 以老疾求近郡，得知磁州。

translations.literal: Because of old age and illness he requested a nearby prefecture and was made prefect of Cizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Because of age and illness he asked for a nearby prefecture and was made prefect of Cizhou.

sentences.zh: 四年，卒，年七十三。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he died, at the age of seventy-three.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died at the age of seventy-three.

sentences.zh: 煦明術數，善相宅，時稱其妙。

translations.literal: Xu was skilled in numerology and good at geomancy; at the time he was called marvelous in these arts.
translations.idiomatic: Xu was skilled in numerology and geomancy and was renowned for it.

sentences.zh: 張佶，字仲雅，本燕人，後徙華州渭南。

translations.literal: Zhang Ji, courtesy name Zhongya, was originally a man of Yan, later migrating to Weinan in Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Ji, whose courtesy name was Zhongya, was originally from Yan and later moved to Weinan in Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 初名志言，後改焉。

translations.literal: His original name was Zhiyan, later changed.
translations.idiomatic: His original name was Zhiyan, which he later changed.

sentences.zh: 父昉，殿中少監。

translations.literal: His father Fang was Junior Director of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: His father Fang was Junior Director of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 佶少有志節，始用蔭補殿前承旨，以習儒業，獻文求試，換國子監丞。

translations.literal: Ji in his youth had determination and integrity; he first entered service by hereditary privilege as Palace Front Commissioner; because he studied Confucian learning he presented writings requesting examination and was changed to Assistant Director of the National University.
translations.idiomatic: Ji had strong character from youth. He entered service by privilege as Palace Front Commissioner, studied Confucian learning, presented writings for examination, and became Assistant Director of the National University.

sentences.zh: 遷著作佐郎、監三白渠、知涇陽縣。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Assistant Editorial Director, supervised the Sanbai Canal, and was made magistrate of Jingyang County.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Assistant Editorial Director, supervised the Sanbai Canal, and was made magistrate of Jingyang County.

sentences.zh: 端拱初，為太子右贊善大夫。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Duangong he became Right Assistant to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Duangong reign he became Right Assistant to the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 曹州民有被誣殺人者，詔往按之，發擿奸伏，冤人得雪。

translations.literal: A man of Caozhou was falsely accused of murder; by edict Ji went to investigate, exposed the hidden villainy, and the wronged man was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: A man in Caozhou was falsely accused of murder. By edict Ji investigated, exposed the hidden crime, and cleared the innocent man.

sentences.zh: 尋通判忻州，遷殿中丞，兼御河督運。

translations.literal: Shortly he was made Vice Prefect of Xinzhou, promoted to Palace Secretariat Attendant, and concurrently Supervisor of Transport on the Imperial Canal.
translations.idiomatic: He soon became Vice Prefect of Xinzhou, then Palace Secretariat Attendant and Supervisor of Transport on the Imperial Canal.

sentences.zh: 至道中，通判陝州，再部送芻糧赴靈武，就改國子博士。

translations.literal: During Zhidao he was Vice Prefect of Shaanzhou, again escorted fodder to Lingwu, and at the same time was changed to Doctor of the National University.
translations.idiomatic: During Zhidao he was Vice Prefect of Shaanzhou, again escorted fodder to Lingwu, and was made Doctor of the National University.

sentences.zh: 咸平初，擢為陝西轉運副使，賜緋魚。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianping he was promoted to Deputy Transport Commissioner of Shaanxi and bestowed red fish insignia.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xianping reign he was made Deputy Transport Commissioner of Shaanxi and given red fish insignia.

sentences.zh: 至延安，遇夏人入寇，親督兵擊敗之。

translations.literal: When he reached Yan'an he encountered the Xia entering to raid and personally directed troops to defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: At Yan'an he met a Tangut raid and personally directed troops to defeat it.

sentences.zh: 三年，徙西川轉運副使。

translations.literal: In the third year he was moved to Deputy Transport Commissioner of Western Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was transferred to Deputy Transport Commissioner of Western Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 時詔討王均，以饋餉之勞，遷虞部員外郎。

translations.literal: At the time an edict ordered the campaign against Wang Jun; for the labor of supplying provisions he was promoted to Outer Gentleman of the Works Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: When court ordered the campaign against Wang Jun, he was promoted to Outer Gentleman of the Works Bureau for supplying the army.

sentences.zh: 賊平，分川峽為四路，以佶為利州路轉運使。

translations.literal: When the bandits were pacified the Sichuan gorges were divided into four circuits; Ji was made Transport Commissioner of Lizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebellion was crushed, the Sichuan gorges were divided into four circuits and Ji was made Transport Commissioner of Lizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 有薦其武幹者，召還，授如京使、涇原鈐轄兼知鎮戎軍。

translations.literal: There were those who recommended his military ability; he was recalled and appointed Commissioner for the Capital, Commissioner of the Jingyuan circuit, and concurrently administrator of Zhenrong Army.
translations.idiomatic: When his military ability was recommended, he was recalled and made Commissioner for the Capital, Commissioner of the Jingyuan circuit, and administrator of Zhenrong Army.

sentences.zh: 徙麟府路鈐轄，夏人來寇，佶率兵與戰，親射殺酋帥，俘獲甚眾，餘黨遁去。

translations.literal: He was moved to Commissioner of the Linfu circuit; when the Xia came to raid, Ji led troops to fight, personally shot and killed a chieftain, captured a great many, and the remainder fled.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Commissioner of the Linfu circuit, he fought a Tangut raid, personally shot a chieftain, captured many prisoners, and drove off the rest.

sentences.zh: 詔書褒之，賜錦袍、金帶。

translations.literal: An edict praised him and bestowed a brocade robe and gold belt.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised him and granted a brocade robe and gold belt.

sentences.zh: 景德中，徙益州鈐轄，加宜州刺史，遷文思使。

translations.literal: During Jingde he was moved to Commissioner of Yizhou, given the additional title of Prefect of Yizhou, and promoted to Commissioner of Literary Elegance.
translations.idiomatic: During Jingde he was transferred to Commissioner of Yizhou, made prefect of Yizhou, and promoted to Commissioner of Literary Elegance.

sentences.zh: 佶御軍撫民，甚有威惠，蜀人久猶懷之。

translations.literal: Ji in commanding the army and comforting the people had great authority and kindness; the people of Shu long afterward still cherished him.
translations.idiomatic: In commanding troops and comforting the people Ji showed great authority and kindness, and the people of Shu long remembered him.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符四年，車駕祀汾陰，以為西京舊城巡檢、鈐轄。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, when the imperial carriage performed the feng sacrifice at Fenyin, he was made Inspector and Commissioner of the old western capital city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, when the emperor performed the feng sacrifice at Fenyin, Ji was made inspector and commissioner of the old western capital city.

sentences.zh: 禮成，加授北作坊使，充趙德明官告使。

translations.literal: When the rites were completed he was given the additional appointment of Commissioner of the Northern Workshops and charged as envoy bearing the patent to Zhao Deming.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were completed he was also made Commissioner of the Northern Workshops and sent as envoy bearing the patent to Zhao Deming.

sentences.zh: 又為鄜延鈐轄。

translations.literal: He again served as Commissioner of the Yan-Yan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He again served as Commissioner of the Yan-Yan circuit.

sentences.zh: 會秦州李浚暴卒，上語近臣曰：「天水邊要，宜速得人。

translations.literal: It happened that Li Jun of Qinzhou died suddenly; the emperor said to his close ministers: "Tianshui is a vital frontier; one must quickly obtain the right man."
translations.idiomatic: When Li Jun of Qinzhou died suddenly, the emperor told his close advisers, "Tianshui is a vital frontier post and needs the right man quickly."

sentences.zh: 」馬知節稱佶可任，上然之，遂改左騏驥使，就命知秦州。

translations.literal: " Ma Zhijie praised Ji as fit for the task; the emperor approved, and thereupon changed him to Commissioner of the Left Imperial Stud and at the same time ordered him to administer Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Zhijie said Ji was fit for the post. The emperor agreed and made him Commissioner of the Left Imperial Stud and prefect of Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 至州，置四門砦，開拓疆境，邊部頗怨。

translations.literal: When he reached the prefecture he established the Four Gates stockade, expanded the frontier territory, and the frontier tribes were quite resentful.
translations.idiomatic: At the prefecture he built the Four Gates stockade and expanded the frontier, provoking strong resentment among the tribes.

sentences.zh: 又臨渭置采木場，戎人不之爭，移帳而去。

translations.literal: He also established a timber-gathering ground at Linwei; the Rong people did not contend for it but moved their camps away.
translations.idiomatic: He also established a timber camp at Linwei. The tribes did not contest it but moved their camps away.

sentences.zh: 佶不甚存撫，亦不奏加賚賜，邊人追悔，引眾劫掠，佶深入掩擊，敗走之。

translations.literal: Ji did not greatly store up comfort and support, nor did he memorialize to add rewards and gifts; the frontier people came to regret it, led crowds in raiding, and Ji made a deep surprise attack and defeated and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Ji did little to comfort the tribes or memorialize for rewards. The frontier people turned hostile, raided in force, and Ji defeated them in a deep surprise attack.

sentences.zh: 議者又欲加恩宗哥、立遵等族，以扼平夏，佶請拒絕之，事具《吐蕃傳》。

translations.literal: Advisers again wished to add favor to the clans of Zongge and Lizun to check Pingxia; Ji requested refusal; the affair is detailed in the Biography of the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: Advisers wished to favor the Zongge and Lizun clans to check Pingxia, but Ji asked that this be refused. The affair is detailed in the Tibetan biography.

sentences.zh: 朝廷始務寧邊，以佶輕信易事，徙邠寧路鈐轄。

translations.literal: The court now devoted itself to securing the frontier; because Ji lightly trusted and easily stirred affairs, he was moved to Commissioner of the Bin-Ning circuit.
translations.idiomatic: As the court sought frontier peace, Ji was transferred to Commissioner of the Bin-Ning circuit for trusting too lightly and stirring trouble.

sentences.zh: 天禧初，召為契丹國信副使，再任邠寧，兼知邠州，遷宮苑使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianxi he was recalled as Deputy Envoy on the Khitan Credentials Mission, again served in Bin-Ning, concurrently administered Binzhou, and was promoted to Commissioner of the Palace Parks.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tianxi reign he was recalled as Deputy Envoy on the Khitan Credentials Mission, again served in Bin-Ning, concurrently administered Binzhou, and was promoted to Commissioner of the Palace Parks.

sentences.zh: 未逾月，擢拜西上閤門使，復為涇原鈐轄。

translations.literal: In less than a month he was promoted to Western Upper Gate Commissioner and again made Commissioner of the Jingyuan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Within a month he was promoted to Western Upper Gate Commissioner and again made Commissioner of the Jingyuan circuit.

sentences.zh: 四年，卒，年六十九。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he died, at the age of sixty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died at the age of sixty-nine.

sentences.zh: 佶涉獵書史，好吟詠，勇敢善射，有方略，其總戎護塞，以威名自任。

translations.literal: Ji ranged widely in books and histories, delighted in composing verse, was brave and skilled in archery, and had strategy; in commanding armies and guarding the frontier he took his authority from his awe-inspiring name.
translations.idiomatic: Ji read widely in history, loved poetry, was brave and skilled in archery, and had sound strategy. In commanding troops and guarding the frontier he relied on his formidable reputation.

sentences.zh: 子宗象，兵部員外郎、直史館、度支判官。

translations.literal: His son Zongxiang became Outer Gentleman of the Military Bureau, Direct Historian of the History Office, and Revenue Judge.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zongxiang became Outer Gentleman of the Military Bureau, Direct Historian of the History Office, and Revenue Judge.

sentences.zh: 論曰：自古盛德之世，未嘗無邊圉之患，要在得果毅之臣以扞禦之。

translations.literal: The commentary says: From antiquity in ages of abundant virtue there have never been lacking troubles on the frontier; the essential lies in obtaining resolute and daring ministers to defend against them.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: Even in ages of highest virtue, frontier troubles have never been absent. What matters is finding resolute ministers able to defend the borders.

sentences.zh: 昔人有言「誰能去兵」，漢祖亦云「安得猛士」，蓋為此也。

translations.literal: Men of old said, "Who can remove arms?" The Founder of Han also said, "Where can I find fierce warriors?"—it was all for this reason.
translations.idiomatic: Men of old asked who could abolish arms, and the Founder of Han lamented where he might find fierce warriors—all for the same reason.

sentences.zh: 李順叛蜀，攻陷郡邑，正捍劍門，斌守梓潼，其績最多。

translations.literal: When Li Shun rebelled in Shu and captured prefectures and counties, Zheng defended Jianmen and Bin held Zitong—their achievements were the greatest.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Shun rebelled in Shu and overran the prefectures, Zheng held Jianmen and Lu Bin defended Zitong. Their achievements stood above the rest.

sentences.zh: 契丹入寇，審玉、繼宣，拔陷將於重圍之中，固有餘勇，佶、煦宣力西南，勤幹威惠，亦皆可取。

translations.literal: When the Khitan invaded, Shenyu and Jixuan rescued trapped generals from heavy encirclement and still had courage to spare; Ji and Xu displayed their strength in the southwest with diligence, capability, authority, and kindness—all likewise worthy of note.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan invaded, Shenyu and Jixuan rescued trapped generals from encirclement and still had fight left in them. Ji and Xu served effectively in the southwest with diligence, authority, and kindness—all likewise commendable.

sentences.zh: 濟、旦以孤城捍強寇，援絕戰死，一代死事之表表者，其可泯諸。

translations.literal: Ji and Dan with lone cities resisted powerful enemies, aid was cut off, and they died in battle—outstanding exemplars of martyrdom in their generation; how could this be forgotten?
translations.idiomatic: Ji and Dan held isolated cities against powerful foes, were cut off from relief, and died fighting—outstanding martyrs of their age whose memory must not fade.
